name: zinterp_context_load_prepared_script_index
description: zInterp_Context::LoadPreparedScriptIndex opens a prepared-script index through the ZRDR search path, validates the header, reads 0x80-byte entries, rejects stale source timestamps, and keeps the index stream/table on success.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c5550 validates the already-open early return, archive-search-list creation from context offset 0x74, prepared stream at 0x80, magic 0x08971119, version 7, 0x80-byte prepared-entry table allocation/read, timestamp freshness check through _stat, success stores at offsets 0x84/0x88/0x8c/0x90, and close/free behavior for stale entries.

The native smokes verify a valid prepared index is accepted and retained, the already-open early return succeeds, and an existing source file with mismatched timestamp rejects the index while leaving the entry count/table unaccepted.
